card.name: Linking words in warning instructions
card.fires_on: Short linking words (new, alternative, other, with, about, initiate) in warning text that tells the reader what to do after an adverse event. Also fires on the digit 2 starting a percentage in adverse-reaction counts.

modes.label: Next-step wording
modes.description: A word right after 'and' or 'immediately' that introduces a replacement or follow-up action after stopping a drug.
modes.example: If paradoxical bronchospasm occurs, STRIVERDI RESPIMAT should be discontinued immediately and<< alternative>> therapy instituted.

modes.label: Percentage digit
modes.description: The digit 2 opening a percentage after a patient count in adverse-reaction results.
modes.example: Febrile neutropenia, which may be life-threatening, occurred in 43/164 patients (<<2>>6%).

card.plain: It marks small words in warning sections that lead into what to do or watch for next, and the first digit of some patient percentages.
